title: Analysis message
description: Body of an AMQP message on exchange scantor.analyses (routing key <scanId>), consumed from queue scantor.scan.<scanId>. Published by the scheduler (attempt 1), by runners for retries (attempt + 1, header x-opt-delivery-time) and by the retry-failed job (round + 1, attempt 1). Consumers must ignore unknown fields (additive changes keep v = 1). See docs/queue.md section 5.2.

analysisId.description: <scanId>-<seq>; must equal scanId + "-" + seq (checked by consumers, not expressible here).

scanId.description: Scan id; equals the routing key.

seq.description: 0-based position of the analysis in the scan's schedule stream.

round.description: Retry-failed generation of the scan (starts at 1).

attempt.description: Attempt number within the round (1-based, at most the scan's maxAttempts, which is at most 20).

config.description: The analysis config. Its serialized size is limited by SCANTOR_MAX_ANALYSIS_CONFIG_BYTES (enforced by the publisher).

scheduledAt.description: Time of the first publish of this seq in this round (server-corrected clock), epoch milliseconds.
